# sh-app-header

**Purpose:** top bar of a screen. Type Title = top-level screens (menu, large title, actions); Back = inner screens (back, centred title, actions); Overlay = translucent bar over photos. Put sh-icon-button / badges in Actions slot.

**Keywords:** app header, top bar, navigation bar, toolbar, title bar, back

Core · 3 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2712-13153) (node `2712:13153`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Type=Overlay

**Purpose:** header over photos — translucent back and actions.

### Type=Title

**Purpose:** top-level screen header — menu, large title, actions.

### Type=Back

**Purpose:** inner screen header — back, centred title, actions.

## Anatomy

Layer tree of `Type=Overlay`. Nested components are shown by name; their internals live in their own blueprint.

- root — column
  - Status bar — **sh-status-bar** (Time 12:30, Platform Android, Theme Dark) · hidden by default
  - Header — row · fill × fixed
    - Navigation — row · hug × hug
      - Back Action — **sh-icon-button** (Icon (Translucent Medium) instance, Icon (Translucent Large) instance, Icon (Medium) instance, Icon (Small) instance, Icon (Large) instance, Icon (Translucent Small) instance, Screen reader label Go back, Badge 2, Type Translucent, Size Small, State Default)
    - Actions — row · hug × hug
      - Photo Action — **sh-icon-button** (Icon (Translucent Medium) instance, Icon (Translucent Large) instance, Icon (Medium) instance, Icon (Small) instance, Icon (Large) instance, Icon (Translucent Small) instance, Screen reader label View photos, Badge 2, Type Translucent, Size Small, State Default)
      - More Action — **sh-icon-button** (Icon (Translucent Medium) instance, Icon (Translucent Large) instance, Icon (Medium) instance, Icon (Small) instance, Icon (Large) instance, Icon (Translucent Small) instance, Screen reader label More options, Badge 2, Type Translucent, Size Small, State Default)
